title: Default roles that already have Delete can change part status
custom_preconds: 1. You can view Administration -> Roles & Permissions, on the build under test.
custom_steps:
1. Confirm editing pricing, editing bin quantities and viewing the inventory list are unchanged by this spec.
  2. Check which default roles have the delete-level setting enabled.
  3. Check a custom role only has the settings explicitly granted.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Editing pricing, editing bin quantities and viewing the inventory list are unchanged; Owner, Administrator and Parts Manager have the delete-level setting enabled by default.
  • Parts Technician, Technician, Service Advisor, Service Manager, Foreman and Office User do not have it by default; a custom role has only the settings explicitly granted to it.

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; "Parts Lifecycle Update" PRD (Confluence 829227015, IN REVIEW 2026-09-09), Story 8 (Permissions); design canvas Vz6rprcWyP16tYxzM1kdeE; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026 against an IN-REVIEW spec; not yet build-verified.
